[SWS_DM_01082] Security level check for sourceDataIdentifier
⌈
On re-
ception of service ’DynamicallyDefineDataIdentifier’ with subfunction ’defineByIdenti-
fier’ and if DiagnosticDynamicallyDefineDataIdentifierClass.checkPer-
SourceId is set to TRUE, the DM shall check if the sourceDataIdentifier can be de-
fined in the current security level according to [SWS_DM_00414]. If the DDID cannot
be defined in the current security level, the DM shall return an NRC 0x33 (securityAc-
cessDenied).
⌋
